title: Hinomori Shiho — Not Used To Makeup〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting. Let's have another good practice today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There you all are.
How was school?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were all so busy getting ready for Shibu Schools Fest until a few days ago, but now you're right back to your regular routine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's kind of sad, right?
It was so much fun, and now it's over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of Shibu Schools Fest.
Have you all had a chance to see the video of the musical?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We were actually watching it just now♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? There's a video of the musical?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. The broadcasting committee took one, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they're apparently thinking of doing the festival again in the future, so they wanted a reference video for the archive.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? This is news to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also didn't hear about this video until after Shibu School Fest had happened.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I brought it over for Miku and the others once I got my hands on a copy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The story was so beautiful.
And it was a nice reminder of why music is such a wonderful thing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
The cast also did a good job of acting.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, they did. Nice work, Ichika.
I didn't know you were so good at acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She did work on her acting skills quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Remember that time after band practice when you suddenly asked me to stand here and pretend to be Lulu? You really startled me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know, but having someone to recite lines to made it easier for me to get into character.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I remember that♪
I wanted to play Lulu too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't ask you because I knew you wouldn't have been able to stop yourself from giggling, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? I so would've stopped...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, you're doing it now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we mustn't forget to mention the band's performance.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. You also did a wonderful job, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I had a chance to listen to the band play as you practiced with them, and you always sounded good. But you were astonishing when it came to the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I just don't want to cut any corners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our songwriters put a huge amount of effort into these songs, so I want to give them the respect they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After all, we only get one chance to play them together like this. If there's anything at all we can do, I want to do it. No regrets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope you can understand where I'm coming from here.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
You're right...
These kinds of opportunities don't come around often, so we should give it our best shot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Everyone in the band decided to give what I said a chance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Anyone could see you really came together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Shih, that reminds me!
You had makeup on during the show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, so...
They really sprang that idea on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It was your big day too, after all. I'm sure they wanted you to look just as sharp.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Oh, by the way, we caught a glimpse of you getting your makeup done.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? When...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were actually hoping to talk to the two of you before heading to our seats.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But everyone was super busy backstage, and we didn't want to get in the way. So, we watched them put your makeup on for a bit, then headed back to our seats.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You seemed kinda embarrassed when they were putting that lipstick on you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, the way they did it just tickled a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And while we're on the subject, I have to think you felt the same way, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... I don't really remember what happened while I was getting my makeup done.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was focusing on ways to keep myself calm, and before I knew it they had finished.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's very like you to do that, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess that's one way to get yourself focused for the show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No fair. I wanted to see them getting their makeup put on too. They should have taken a video of that part, too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They said the recording was for reference purposes, right? Then I have to believe someone took video of everything that went on behind the scenes, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Probably.
But I can't say for sure if that includes makeup.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no way they caught us right at that moment.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, we won't know until we actually see it for ourselves! Ichi, you gotta find it and—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I think that's enough chatting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have our hands full as it is getting ready for Jam Fest, so we're gonna get back in the saddle and practice like we really mean it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi...
I'm willing to wait for as long as I have to for that video.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What was that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
N-Nothing! Honest!
Alright, let's have a really great practice today♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
